recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If future work updates stale Invoice ModelInfo references to the old Invoice.PriceComponent backbone, handle it under FHIR-16380 or a dedicated ModelInfo issue rather than reopening this factor/amount wording correction.
issue_request: FHIR-16382 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient Administration correction stating that the names/definitions of Invoice.lineItem.priceComponent.factor and Invoice.lineItem.priceComponent.amount were swapped; Jira says to change as pre-applied.
initial_application: Git-svn commit c7f8830902, corresponding to revision 13742, applied GF#16382 by moving the factor short/definition to the factor row and the amount short/definition to the amount row in the historical Invoice spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Invoice remains active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-16380 later refactored Invoice.lineItem.priceComponent and Invoice.totalPriceComponent to use the active MonetaryComponent metadata type. MonetaryComponent.factor is decimal with factor-calculation text, and MonetaryComponent.amount is Money with explicit-amount text. A diagram-like Invoice SVG and legacy ModelInfo references were treated as non-authoritative or separate FHIR-16380-family cleanup, not as a remaining FHIR-16382 swap.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope authoritative source already carries the corrected factor/amount semantics requested by FHIR-16382, so an empty audit commit was published.

related_jiras.note: Converted Invoice.lineItem.priceComponent and Invoice.totalPriceComponent to the MonetaryComponent metadata type while preserving corrected factor/amount semantics.
